sections.heading: Emergency situations — C2
sections.markdown:
FACT_ID: sec12-R01 | anchor: A77
After a crash, move the vehicle as far off the roadway as possible; if it cannot move, activate hazards and place available road flares. [A77]
Source: [A77 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0077]

FACT_ID: sec12-R02 | anchor: A77
Stop and promptly warn approaching traffic with hazard lights; after a minor crash, remove the vehicle from moving traffic if possible and safe. [A77]
Source: [A77 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0077]

FACT_ID: sec12-R03 | anchor: A77
Stay calm after a crash and avoid arguing. [A77]
Source: [A77 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0077]

FACT_ID: sec12-R04 | anchor: A77
Do not leave a crash scene before exchanging contact and insurance information, including leaving a note for an unoccupied damaged vehicle. [A77]
Source: [A77 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0077]

FACT_ID: sec12-R05 | anchor: A77
Check yourself and other people for injuries after a crash. [A77]
Source: [A77 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0077]

FACT_ID: sec12-R06 | anchor: A78
Call nine one one when anyone has been injured in a crash. [A78]
Source: [A78 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec12-R07 | anchor: A78
The handbook directs keeping injured people warm without moving them. [A78]
Source: [A78 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec12-R08 | anchor: A78
Notify the appropriate Ohio State Highway Patrol, sheriff or local police after a crash. [A78]
Source: [A78 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec12-R09 | anchor: A78
Exchange crash information without discussing fault or insurance coverage. [A78]
Source: [A78 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec12-R10 | anchor: A78
Collect names and addresses of the people involved in a crash and its witnesses. [A78]
Source: [A78 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec12-R11 | anchor: A78
Collect the vehicle owner's name and contact information if that owner is not present or involved. [A78]
Source: [A78 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec12-R12 | anchor: A78
Record the plates, makes and models of the vehicles involved in the crash. [A78]
Source: [A78 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec12-R13 | anchor: A78
Exchange the insurance company's name and address and the policy number after a crash. [A78]
Source: [A78 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec12-R14 | anchor: A78
Record the sequence of events, weather, road conditions and traffic controls associated with a crash. [A78]
Source: [A78 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec12-R15 | anchor: A78
Answer the investigating officer's questions and avoid discussing the crash with other people. [A78]
Source: [A78 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec12-R16 | anchor: A78
Notify your insurer as soon as possible after a crash. [A78]
Source: [A78 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec12-R17 | anchor: A78
After a crash involving an unattended vehicle, report it to police or leave the required information at the scene. [A78]
Source: [A78 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec12-R18 | anchor: A78
An Ohio crash driver may file form B M V three three zero three within six months if there was personal injury or more than four hundred dollars in damage and the other driver or owner lacked insurance or financial-responsibility coverage. [A78]
Source: [A78 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0078]

Confusables: an engine failure calls for steady braking, while a tire blowout calls for gradual slowing without braking. Neutral is the stated first gear response to an uncontrolled accelerator. Mnemonic: control, clear, warn. Glossary: a drop-off is leaving the paved road surface; an inoperative signal is treated as the stated stop unless police direct traffic. These terms restate the cited instructions only.
